research_findings: Investigated the codebase to find JSON parsing vulnerabilities based on the `.jules/squash.md` directives.
Identified that `src/lib/langgraph.ts` (which handles LLM responses via `JSON.parse`) was vulnerable to crashes if the AI returned malformed JSON (e.g. including markdown wrapping).
Identified that unhandled `JSON.parse` failures on LLM responses can lead to broken feedback loops.
features_improved: Hardened `getFeedback` and `getInterviewSummary` in `src/lib/langgraph.ts` by wrapping `JSON.parse` in try-catch blocks and providing safe fallbacks.
next_steps_for_next_run: Review the timeout cancellation strategy (e.g. `timeoutIds.current`) in more widgets to ensure they aren't leaking on unmount, and implement stricter Try/Catch around JSON parsing in UI components.
